correctness.rationale: Centered C_n/(n+1) is an L²-bounded martingale: external gap depth identity sum=C_n+2n gives its exact conditional mean; insertion depth is dominated in second moment by lower record maxima and upper record minima, giving L² tail E|M_n-M_k|=O((1+log k)/sqrt(k)). Inversions on the last n-k inputs are independent of M_k; omitted centered inversion pairs are bounded by kn, hence O(k/sqrt(n)) after n^(3/2) normalization. Lipschitz covariance substitutions yield inequality (1), optimizing k yields n^(-1/6)(log n)^(2/3), and CLT follows from independent insertion-rank inversion decomposition with variance asymptotic 1/36. Reflection of every key leaves Quicksort cost unchanged but complements inversion count, yielding exact conditional symmetry/covariance 0. Independent enumeration 5,913 permutations n<=7 validates conditional reflection and covariance; independence in the limit rests on analytic martingale+tightness proof.
